title: 第81章 武功不行，那就科技来填！

content_zh: 回到西院的小院中，唐逸便看到屋内灯光摇曳。　　昏暗的烛光下，杜凌菲正在给唐音补衣服，而唐音则双手撑在桌上，有一搭没一搭地打瞌睡。　　而在两人的面前，已经摆好了几样小菜。　　显然她们晚餐还没有吃，正在等他。　　见到这一幕，唐逸嘴角微微扬起。　　和东院那群家伙比起来，还是这小小的院里有点家的气息。　　“音音，我回来了。”　　唐逸故意在门外咳嗽一声，就看到原本睡眼惺忪的唐音整个人瞬间清醒，从凳子上跳下来便往门外扑来。　　“哥哥，你怎么现在才回来啊？我们等你吃饭都等好久了呢。”　　唐音扑进唐逸怀里，唐逸将她抱起来诧异看向杜凌菲：“呃，你居然……还会做饭？”　　他有些震惊，杜凌菲一看出身书香门第，气质高雅，她竟然还会下厨？　　杜凌菲放下唐音的裙子有些尴尬，唐音双手揽着唐逸的脖子先开了口：“我们去学的，我们今天特意去餐馆学的。”　　唐逸听到这话嘴角微微抽了抽，愕然瞅着杜凌菲：“你，第一次？”　　杜凌菲背着手笑了笑，道：“短时间内，我恐怕回不去了，没事做索性就学了点，节省开销。”　　“那个……你尝尝？”　　杜凌菲双手抬起，指尖指着桌上的几道菜。　　唐逸凑近一看，面色就有些僵硬，鱼糊了，肉没熟，汤没油，鸡腿勉强还算得过去……唐逸不想拂了杜美女的面子，夹了一块鸡腿咬了一口，结果肉刚刚拉起来，血丝就出来了。　　好嘛，没烤熟！　　关键是没烤熟就算了，还没放盐。　　唐逸：“……”　　合着你们俩不是等我回来吃饭，是等我回来试毒的吧？　　不是下馆子学习去了吗？你们这学习的效果……不怎么样啊！　　“呃，那个……第一次做，难免有点生疏。”　　“再多做几次，就……就熟悉了。”　　杜凌菲戳了戳手指，有点尴尬，唐逸见到她这模样顿时有些诧异，杜凌菲在他的印象中是那种安静端庄的美女，没想到竟然还有这么……小女人的一面。　　别说，还挺可爱的。　　就是这话吧，容易让人误会。　　什么叫第一次生疏，做几次就熟悉了，这是什么虎狼之词。　　“咳，做得很不错，下回别做了，找个厨娘我亲自教吧。”　　唐逸将唐音放下来，端着桌上的菜重新回了厨房。　　他上班没时间，让杜凌菲做饭是不可能的了，再让他捣鼓下去，估计唐音和她说不定哪一天就得食物中毒。　　唐音和杜凌菲相视一眼，都吐了吐舌头，其实她们俩早就知道做得难吃了，之所以等唐逸回来，不是等他吃饭，而是等他回来加工的。　　果然，经过唐逸重新回炉重造后的饭菜，不是一般的好吃。　　唐音埋头干饭，杜凌菲给她夹了一个鸡腿道：“有件事需要告诉你下，你上暗榜追杀令了，悬赏金额五千两。”　　唐逸看了一眼唐音，见小姑娘一副我早知道的样子，摇了摇头道：“暗榜追杀令？那是什么东西？”　　杜凌菲眯着美眸看了一眼唐逸，暗榜追杀令他竟然不知道？　　想到这家伙以前的遭遇，好像不知道也挺正常。　　“是暗金楼的任务榜。”　　杜凌菲放下筷子，道：“暗京楼是江湖上恶名昭彰的杀手组织，无恶不作，没有下限，只要给钱什么任务都接。”　　“悬赏上了暗金榜，杀手便会从暗金榜接任务，目标不死，暗金楼的杀手就不会停止追杀，因此暗京楼的任务榜，也称为暗榜追杀令。”　　“所以，你要小心。”　　唐逸微微皱眉，道：“他们敢对锦衣卫动手？”　　杜凌菲像看傻子一般看着唐逸，道：“只要钱给得够多，他们敢杀皇帝。”　　唐逸脸色顿时就阴沉下来，你要这么说的话，那我可就要认真了。　　我是忌惮这个世界的武功，但并不代表我害怕这个世界的武功，我倒是挺期待这个世界的武功，能不能像火云邪神一样能徒手接住子弹。　　以及，炸弹。　　“嗯，我知道了，我会小心的。”　　唐逸抬手揉了揉唐音的脑袋，唐音是他唯一的软肋：“暗京楼没有彻底解决之前，这段时间你帮我照顾下唐音。”　　听到这话杜凌菲瞳孔微缩，这家伙说什么？解决暗京楼？　　我和你说这个消息，是这个意思吗？　　我是要你小心一点，谁让你去解决暗京楼了？　　你知道暗京楼是什么样的存在吗？那是连陛下都忌惮的杀手组织，其中高手无数，要是利益足够大，他们甚至敢组团袭击皇宫。　　你一个连武功都不会的家伙，要解决暗京楼？　　陛下都没做到的事情，你能做到？　　“你……认真的？”杜凌菲微微皱眉，美眸盯着唐逸。　　唐音看了眼唐逸，又看了眼唐音，道：“杜姐姐，我哥哥很厉害的，他说解决，那就一定能解决。”　　虽然担心，但唐音现在对哥哥很有信心，哥哥不会骗人的。　　唐逸抬手揉了揉唐音的脑袋，看向杜凌菲道：“当然是认真的，但前提是，我让你准备的东西，你准备好了吗？”　　杜凌菲沉吟了一下，微微点点头。　　唐逸去锦衣卫的时候，在房间的桌上留下了他想要的东西，硫磺，硝石，木炭等等。　　她带着唐音在京都转了一天，所有东西都算是备齐。　　现在唐逸提到这些东西，她震惊道：“东西都准备好了，只是你要这些东西做什么？”　　“那是自然，这弄好了，可是大杀伤力武器。”唐逸笑了。　　杀手又怎样？　　想杀我？先问我的炸弹答不答应。　　吃过夜宵，唐逸便带着材料潜回了东院，在唐敬的书房中开始配黑火药，这东西很危险，他可不敢在杜凌菲和唐音的院中配。　　当然，除了黑火药，唐逸的造枪的计划也提上了日程。　　前世对各种枪械他都有深刻的了解，各种改装对他来说轻轻松松，要炼出强度足够的钢也不是太难……难的是现在的锻造技术，可能达不到他想要的水平。　　对于子弹所需的材料，对他这个西北理工出来的高材生，问题也不大。　　武功不行，只能科技来填！
content_en: Returning to the small courtyard in the west courtyard, Tang Yi saw the lights flickering in the house.Under the dim candlelight, Du Lingfei was mending Tang Yin's clothes, while Tang Yin rested his hands on the table and dozed off.In front of the two of them, several side dishes have been placed.Apparently they haven't eaten dinner yet and are waiting for him.Seeing this scene, the corners of Tang Yi's mouth raised slightly.Compared with the guys in the east courtyard, this small courtyard still has a bit of a homey atmosphere."Yinyin, I'm back." Tang Yi deliberately coughed outside the door, and saw Tang Yin, who was originally sleepy, suddenly wake up, jump off the stool and rush towards the door."Brother, why are you back now? We've been waiting for you to eat for a long time." Tang Yin threw herself into Tang Yi's arms. Tang Yi picked her up and looked at Du Lingfei in surprise: "Uh, you actually...can cook?" He was a little shocked. Du Lingfei saw that she came from a scholarly family and had an elegant temperament. She could actually cook?Du Lingfei put down Tang Yin's skirt and felt a little embarrassed. Tang Yin put her hands around Tang Yi's neck and spoke first: "We went to learn it. We went to the restaurant to learn it today." When Tang Yi heard this, the corners of his mouth twitched slightly and he looked at Du Lingfei in shock: "You, the firstOnce?" Du Lingfei smiled with her hands behind her back and said, "I'm afraid I won't be able to go back in the short term.I'll just learn something to save money when I have nothing to do." "Um...you try it?" Du Lingfei raised her hands and pointed at the dishes on the table.Tang Yi took a closer look and saw that his face was a little stiff. The fish was mushy, the meat was undercooked, the soup had no oil, and the chicken legs were just passable... Tang Yi didn't want to offend Du Mei's face, so he took a piece of chicken legs and took a bite. As a result, bloodshot eyes came out as soon as the meat was pulled up.Okay, it’s not cooked yet!The key is that it’s okay if it’s not cooked yet, and you haven’t added any salt yet.Tang Yi: "..." Co-author: You two are not waiting for me to come back for dinner, but for me to come back to test the poison, right?Didn’t you go to a restaurant to study?The effect of your study... is not very good!"Well, um... it's the first time I've done it, so it's a bit unfamiliar." "If you do it a few more times, you'll be familiar with it." Du Lingfei poked her finger, a little embarrassed. Tang Yi was a little surprised when he saw her like this. In his impression, Du Lingfei was a quiet and dignified beauty, but he didn't expect that she had such a... little girly side.Don’t tell me, it’s quite cute.That’s it. It’s easy for people to misunderstand.What does it mean to be unfamiliar the first time, but to become familiar after doing it a few times? This is the saying of a tiger or a wolf."Ahem, you did a good job. Don't do it next time. Find a cook and I will teach you personally." Tang Yi put Tang Yin down and returned to the kitchen with the dishes on the table.He didn't have time to go to work, so it was impossible for Du Lingfei to cook. If he continued to mess around, Tang Yin and she might get food poisoning one day.Tang Yin and Du Lingfei looked at each other and stuck out their tongues. In fact, they both knew that the cooking was unpalatable. The reason why they waited for Tang Yi to come back was not to wait for him to eat, but to wait for him to come back to process it.Sure enough, the food after Tang Yi's re-making was not as delicious as usual.Tang Yin was immersed in cooking, and Du Lingfei gave her a chicken leg and said, "I need to tell you something. You have been put on a fatwa, and the reward is five thousand taels." Tang Yi glanced at Tang Yin, and seeing the little girl's expression of knowing I had known it, he shook his head and said, "A fatwa? What is that?" Du Lingfei narrowed her beautiful eyes and glanced at Tang Yi. He didn't know about the fatwa?Thinking about what happened to this guy in the past, it seems quite normal not to know."It's the task list of the Dark Gold Tower." Du Lingfei put down her chopsticks and said, "The Dark Gold Tower is a notorious killer organization in the world. It does all kinds of evil and has no lower limit. As long as you give money, it will take on any task." "If the reward is on the Dark Gold Tower, the killer will take the task from the Dark Gold Tower. If the target is not dead, the killers of the Dark Gold Tower will not stop hunting. Therefore, the Dark Gold Tower's assassins will not stop hunting."So, you have to be careful."Tang Yi frowned slightly and said, "Do they dare to attack the Jin Yiwei?"Du Lingfei looked at Tang Yi as if he was a fool and said, "As long as the money is enough, they dare to kill the emperor."Tang Yi's face suddenly darkened. If you want to say that, then I will take it seriously.I am afraid of the martial arts in this world, but it does not mean that I am afraid of the martial arts in this world. I am really looking forward to the martial arts in this world, whether I can catch bullets with my bare hands like the Fire Cloud Evil God.And, bombs."Well, I know, I will be careful." Tang Yi raised his hand and rubbed Tang Yin's head. Tang Yin was his only weakness: "Until Anjing Tower is completely solved, you can help me take care of Tang Yin during this period." Du Lingfei's pupils shrank when he heard this. What did this guy say?Solve Anjing Tower?Is this what I mean when I tell you this news?I want you to be careful. Who asked you to deal with Anjing Tower?Do you know what kind of existence Anjing Tower is?That is a killer organization that even His Majesty is afraid of. There are countless masters among them. If the benefits are big enough, they would even dare to form a group to attack the palace.You, a guy who doesn't even know martial arts, want to deal with Anjing Tower?What can you do that even His Majesty has not done?"Are you...serious?" Du Lingfei frowned slightly, staring at Tang Yi with her beautiful eyes.Tang Yin glanced at Tang Yi, then at Tang Yin, and said, "Sister Du, my brother is very powerful. If he says it can be solved, it will be solved." Although Tang Yin was worried, Tang Yin now had great confidence in his brother, who would not lie to others.Tang Yi raised his hand and rubbed Tang Yin's head, looked at Du Lingfei and said, "Of course I am serious, but the premise is, are you ready for what I asked you to prepare?" Du Lingfei pondered for a moment and nodded slightly.When Tang Yi went to Jinyiwei, he left what he wanted on the table in the room, including sulfur, saltpeter, charcoal, etc.She took Tang Yin around Kyoto for a day, and everything was ready.Now that Tang Yi mentioned these things, she was shocked and said: "Everything is ready, but what do you want these things for?" "That's natural, this is done, but it is a weapon of mass destruction." Tang Yi smiled.What about the killer?Want to kill me?First ask me if the bomb will be answered.
